verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of automatic retry on transient failures or checkpoint-based resume for interrupted syncs. The closest material—CDC log position tracking (airbyte-docs-15/25/38/42) and incremental sync (airbyte-docs-22)—describes how CDC/incremental modes only pull changed data, not failure-recovery behavior, and a community anecdote (airbyte-comm-4) describes a customer having to manually 'trick' Airbyte into completing a large sync rather than it resuming automatically. No first-party claim about retry-on-failure or checkpoint resume is present to substantiate this story.
